description: This Java class, ShardIdExtractor, implements the PubSubTopicExtractor interface to extract shard IDs from messages for pub/sub topics, utilizing an instance of ShardRegionExtractor.

classes.name: ShardIdExtractor
classes.description: A final class that extracts shard IDs from messages to be used as pub/sub topics, parameterized by message type T.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ShardIdExtractor with the provided ShardRegionExtractor.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Implements method from PubSubTopicExtractor interface to retrieve the shard ID from a message as a singleton collection.
